name: io.github.lx1112/onchaincheck-dev
title: OnchainCheck Dev Docs
description: npm/PyPI package docs and source, docs pages and PDFs as Markdown, fetch. Pay per call (x402)

tools.name: package_check
tools.description: Is this package safe to install? npm, PyPI, Go, Cargo, Maven, NuGet or RubyGems: OSV vulnerabilities and malicious-package reports with severity and fixing version, deprecation, licenses, OpenSSF Scorecard and an ok / review / upgrade / avoid verdict. npm and PyPI also get supply-chain checks: names that don't exist (invented by a model), lookalikes of popular packages, newly added install scripts, a publisher who wasn't a maintainer, downloads. Costs $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: packages_check
tools.description: Audit up to 20 dependencies in one call: paste a package.json or requirements.txt, or list packages (npm:lodash@4.17.15; npm, PyPI, Go, Cargo, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems). Each gets OSV vulnerabilities and malware reports with severity and fixing version, deprecation, licenses and an ok/review/upgrade/avoid verdict; npm and PyPI names that don't exist (invented by a model) and lookalikes of popular packages are flagged. Plus a summary. Data: deps.dev, OSV.dev, registries. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

packages.description: Comma- or newline-separated ecosystem:name@version (version optional: latest)

manifest.description: package.json or requirements.txt contents, instead of packages

ecosystem.description: Default ecosystem for entries without a prefix

tools.name: package_docs
tools.description: Package docs and source for coding agents, in one call: give an npm or PyPI package name (and optional version) and get its README as Markdown, description, license, repository, entry points and types, exports, dependencies and the full file list; pass file=<path> to read one source or type file (npm). From the npm registry, jsDelivr and PyPI. Costs $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

name.description: Package name, optionally with @version (react, @types/node, requests, expo-widgets@58.0.29)

file.description: npm only: a path from files to read (src/index.ts, dist/index.d.ts)

readme.description: false leaves out the README (default true)

tools.name: web_extract
tools.description: Page to Markdown for an LLM: give any URL (article, docs page, blog, PDF or Word file) and get its main text as clean Markdown, with navigation, header, footer, forms and scripts dropped, plus title, description, language, author, publish date, image and word count. PDFs and Office documents are converted to text. Optional links=true adds the page's links. Text and JSON URLs come back as-is. Costs $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

links.description: true adds the page's links (up to 300)

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL for an agent and get the response as sent: HTTP status, content type, key headers, the redirect chain, timing and the raw body (HTML, JSON, XML or text, up to 500 KB). For public JSON APIs, registry entries, raw source files, feeds and sitemaps. Use /web/extract for a page or PDF as clean Markdown, /docs/package for a package's docs. Public http(s) URLs only. Costs $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: web_contents
tools.description: Read up to 5 web pages in one call as clean text for an LLM, in the Exa /contents shape: POST {urls: [...], text: {maxCharacters}} and get results with url, title, author, publishedDate, image and the main text as Markdown (navigation, header, footer and scripts dropped), plus a per-URL status. One flat price per call. Costs $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web: up to 10 results for a query, most relevant first, each with title, URL, publish date, author and the passage of the page that best matches the query. Optional filters: category (news, company, publication, people...), domains to include or exclude, and since (YYYY-MM-DD) for recent pages only. Pair with /web/contents to read the pages. Costs $0.006 USDC on Base via x402.

category.description: Limit to one kind of page

since.description: Only pages published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

snippets.description: false leaves out the matching passages (default true)

tools.name: document_to_markdown
tools.description: PDF to text: convert a document at a URL to Markdown for an LLM, keeping headings and tables: PDF, Word (DOCX), Excel (XLSX, XLS), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS), CSV and XML, up to 20 MB. For reports, filings, papers, invoices and spreadsheets. Returns the Markdown with character, word and token counts. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: extract_tables
tools.description: Extract the tables from a document as typed JSON: send text (CSV, TSV, semicolon or pipe separated, Markdown tables or HTML), html, or a url to a web page or CSV file. Each table gets headers (multi-row headers joined, colspan and rowspan expanded), column types (number, percent, currency, date, boolean, string) and rows with parsed values. Deterministic, no model; up to 20 tables and 500 rows each. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

text.description: CSV, TSV, Markdown or HTML text containing tables

url.description: A public web page or CSV file, instead of text

tools.name: example_output
tools.description: Free. Shows what a paid tool on this server returns: its price, an example input and the output captured from a real paid call. Tools: package_check, packages_check, package_docs, web_extract, web_fetch, web_contents, web_search, document_to_markdown, extract_tables.

tool.description: Name of a paid tool on this server
